name: instro-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is instro (`instro`), a typed Python library for test-and-measurement
instruments: hardware abstraction layers for power supplies, digital multimeters, electronic loads, DAQs and
oscilloscopes, vendor drivers built on VISA and Modbus transports, publishers that route measurements and
commands to files and other destinations, DAQ scalers, and bundled SCPI simulators of a power supply and a
multimeter.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The implementation in scope is every Python module under instro/. The documentation in scope is README.md, these guide pages under docs/guides/instrumentation/: overview.mdx, quickstart.mdx, library.mdx, exceptions.mdx, publishers.mdx, custom-instruments.mdx, psu.mdx, psu-simulator.mdx, dmm.mdx, dmm-simulator.mdx, eload.mdx, daq.mdx, oscilloscope.mdx, cli.mdx, transports/overview.mdx, transports/visa.mdx, transports/modbus.mdx and protocols/modbus.mdx, and the module, class and function docstrings of the modules under instro/.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples. In-package code comments are only supporting
evidence; when they conflict with the documentation, follow the documentatio
